headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped two-week gains as surging crude oil prices weighed on market sentiment.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging crude oil prices touching multi-month highs of $117 per barrel dragged down market sentiment.
Elevated energy costs triggered concerns over profit margins for domestic companies.
Profit booking across sectors contributed to snapping a two-week winning streak.
Global market cues and geopolitical tensions kept investor sentiment cautious.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 26 October.
AU Small Finance Bank reported a 53% jump in Q2 net profit to ₹858 crore.
Kotak Mahindra Bank posted a 26% increase in Q2 net profit aided by better asset quality.
BPCL reported a 22.5% drop in Q2 profit to ₹4,993 crore due to fuel price freezes.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian equities snapped their two-week winning streak as surging crude oil prices dragged down key indices. Meanwhile, Q2 earnings season saw strong reports from banking names like AU Small Finance Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank, while BPCL felt the pinch of frozen fuel prices. Markets remain closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 26 October.
